items.text: Alipay: install, verify passport, link a foreign card
WeChat: install, sign in, add WeChat Pay with a foreign card if it accepts one
DiDi: install it, or find DiDi inside Alipay, and add payment
Amap (高德地图): install and try one search
Apple Translate: download Thai and Chinese (Mandarin) for offline
Google Translate: download Chinese and Thai offline packs
eSIM or roaming that routes outside China: install and test before flying
Bank app: turn on overseas use for the cards linked to Alipay
Open this trip site online once and add it to the home screen
Some yuan cash in small notes as a backup
Power bank in carry-on, 100 Wh or less, rating printed on it
Touchscreen gloves, so the phone works outside
